title: CRM account snapshot

title: Support escalation SUP-1042
body: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Account: Cedar Labs (cedar-001). SUP-1042 remains open on October 9, 2026. Recurring data-sync failures delayed the customer's operations dashboard on October 5 and October 8. Workaround available; permanent fix not verified. Engineering owner: Taylor Quinn, Integrations. Customer reports loss of confidence in dashboard accuracy. No confirmed SLA breach or root cause is recorded.

title: Product adoption report
body: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Account: Cedar Labs (cedar-001). Weekly active users declined from 120 in the week ending September 27 to 72 in the week ending October 11: a 40% decline. Paid seats: 200. Telemetry pipeline freshness: October 11. Data establishes a decline, but does not prove sync incidents caused it. No survey evidence explaining the decline is available.

title: Account ownership and responsibilities
body: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Account: Cedar Labs (cedar-001). Jordan Lee is the CSM and recovery coordinator. Taylor Quinn owns the integration investigation and fix verification. Casey Reed is the CX leadership escalation contact. Morgan Chen was the executive sponsor and has moved teams. A new customer sponsor is unknown. CSM coordinates the recovery plan; engineering owns technical milestones; CX leadership validates any Red classification.

title: Customer recovery playbook
body: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Risk tiers: Green (no validated concern), Yellow (emerging signal), Orange (multiple material unresolved signals), Red (severe validated business risk confirmed by CX leadership). Do not classify Red solely from renewal proximity. Recovery workflow: CSM validates signals, confirms ownership, agrees measurable milestones with the customer, and conducts weekly reviews. Proposed actions must be marked as proposals. Missing information lowers confidence. Recovery requires sustained customer outcomes and verified reliability, not just closing a ticket or reaching renewal. Cite source evidence and distinguish customer statements from model inference.

title: Billing and renewal record
body: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Account: Cedar Labs (cedar-001). Contract term ends November 30, 2026. Annual contract value: $240,000 for 200 paid seats. All invoices paid on time; no open billing disputes. Renewal quote not yet sent. Expansion opportunity for 80 additional seats (estimated $96,000) is marked On hold as of October 6, 2026 with reason 'customer request'. Renewal notice deadline is 60 days before term end. Billing data does not indicate customer intent to renew or cancel.

title: Customer survey responses Q3
body: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Account: Cedar Labs (cedar-001). Q3 relationship survey closed October 3, 2026. 9 of 200 seat holders responded (4.5% response rate). NPS for responders: +11, down from +38 in Q2. Two operations analysts cited 'dashboard numbers not matching source data'. One admin praised onboarding support. Small sample: results are directional and not representative of the full account. No respondent mentioned cancellation.

title: Draft incident review: data-sync failures
body: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Account: Cedar Labs (cedar-001). Related ticket: SUP-1042. DRAFT, not yet reviewed. Author: Taylor Quinn, Integrations. Leading hypothesis: connector retries time out when the customer's warehouse exports exceed 2 GB, leaving partial syncs. Hypothesis is unconfirmed. Candidate fix: chunked export with checkpointing, targeted for staging verification the week of October 12. Production rollout date not set. Two other accounts use the same connector; impact on them is not assessed.

title: Internal escalation thread
body: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Account: Cedar Labs (cedar-001). October 8 internal thread. Jordan Lee (CSM): customer ops lead asked whether dashboard data from the past two weeks can be trusted. Taylor Quinn (Integrations): workaround is a manual re-sync, which support ran on October 8; root cause still under investigation. Casey Reed (CX leadership): asked to be updated before any Red classification or customer executive outreach. No commitments or dates were given to the customer in this thread.

title: Quarterly business review summary
body: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Account: Cedar Labs (cedar-001). August 20 QBR with executive sponsor Morgan Chen. Customer goals: replace spreadsheet reporting for the operations team and expand to the finance team in Q4. Agreed success metric: 150 weekly active users by end of Q4 2026. title: Customer operations lead email
body: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA. Account: Cedar Labs (cedar-001). Email from the customer operations lead to Jordan Lee, October 9. Paraphrased: the team has returned to spreadsheets for daily reporting until sync failures are resolved; they want a written root-cause summary and a date for a verified fix; expansion to finance will not be scheduled until then. The email does not mention renewal or cancellation. The operations lead is not identified as the new executive sponsor.
